posts.title: Digital Exodus: Your Practical Escape Plan from Big Tech
posts.description: I've been wanting to make this post for a long time. Digital colonialism, the slaver of our century, has ravaged the internet commons. It has tamed, capitalized and lobotomized the early-2000s "wild west" era of the internet, replacing it with walled gardens of authoritarianism: Amazon, Google, Facebook, YouTube.
